title: How to Tailor Your Resume to a Job Description | Job Matching Mode
description:
The job description  your resume. 

Tailoring your resume to a specific job description can increase your interview chances by showing the recruiter and hiring manager how great a match your skillset is for a role—but customizing your resume for every job application can be time-consuming and stressful. How do you know what keywords to include? And where to put them? 

Use Teal's Matching Mode to optimize your resume and increase your odds of landing an interview. 

In this video we'll touch on: 

00:00 Introduction
00:17 Pick which job you're tailoring a resume for
01:04 NEW: Resume Matching Mode
02:03 Finding existing keywords in your resume
02:47 Do you need to be a 100% match?
03:01 Adding high-priority keywords to your achievements
04:01 Review the job description & see what to add
04:46 A hack to fit in more keywords
05:09 Outro
